description: This file defines classes and types for handling shape patterns and data layers in a map widget, including pattern processing for colors, images, and stripes, as well as style generation for map shapes.

classes.name: ShapePatternProcessor
classes.description: Abstract class for processing shape patterns based on settings, capable of creating patterns from color, image, or stripe fill types.

classes.name: ShapeColorPatternProcessor
classes.description: Handles pattern creation for color fill types.

classes.name: ShapeImagePatternProcessor
classes.description: Handles pattern creation for image fill types, including loading images and applying aspect ratio settings.

classes.name: ShapeStripePatternProcessor
classes.description: Handles pattern creation for stripe fill types, including color processing for stripes and spaces.

classes.name: TbShapesDataLayer
classes.description: Abstract class for map data layers that use shape patterns, providing methods to get shape styles and stroke styles based on pattern processing.

methods.name: fromSettings
methods.description: Factory method to create specific pattern processor based on fill type.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes pattern processors, such as loading functions or colors.

methods.name: computePattern
methods.description: Abstract method to compute pattern info based on data.

methods.name: processPattern
methods.description: Processes data to generate a pattern with an ID.

methods.name: patternFromPatternInfo
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a pattern object from pattern info.

methods.name: constructPattern
methods.description: Constructs a pattern object based on pattern info, including color, image, or stripe patterns.

methods.name: getStrokeStyle
methods.description: Returns an observable of style options for shape stroke, including pattern ID.

methods.name: getShapeStyle
methods.description: Returns an observable of style options for filled shape, including pattern and color.

methods.name: allColorSettings
methods.description: Returns all color settings used in the shape style.

methods.name: doSetup
methods.description: Initial setup for shape pattern and stroke color processors.

methods.name: loadPatternInfoFromImage
methods.description: Loads image and creates pattern info for image fill types.
